title: New Homes in Central Texas
description:
➡️Ready to buy a new home in the Central Texas area? Schedule a call here: https://calendly.com/soldwithkyla/30min
 
I work with buyers and sellers throughout Central TX. Whether you're looking to buy land to build a custom home, already living local and looking to move for life changes, or you'll just be in Central Texas for a few years stationed at Fort Hood or completing you're Residency at BS&W, I've got you covered. 

Moving to or from Fort Hood or Central TX? We have real estate partners around the world to help get you sold and into a new home at your next destination!

Areas we cover: Temple, Belton, Salado, Troy, Killeen, Fort Hood, Harker Heights, Nolanville, Copperas Cove, Gatesville, Greater Waco area, and Greater Austin area. 

Kyla Montano | Licensed Texas REALTOR® (775318)

Welcome to our second exclusive interview with Bradley Johnston, representative of Jubilee Homes! In this video, @SoldWithKyla and Bradley chat all things about their gorgeous new homes in the sought-after Drakes Landing subdivision located in beautiful Salado, Texas. 

As a part of our real estate series focusing on builder information, we take a deep dive into understanding the vision behind Jubilee Homes' latest project. Bradley gives us the inside scoop on the unique features of the homes being constructed, the amenities of the community, and the perks of living in Drakes Landing. From state-of-the-art kitchens to spacious backyards, these homes are designed with a blend of modern aesthetics and traditional warmth.

Whether you are a prospective home buyer, a real estate enthusiast, or simply curious about life in Salado, this video is going to be a valuable resource. Bradley’s insight offers a behind-the-scenes look at the process of constructing these beautiful homes in Drakes Landing. 

Don't forget to give this video a thumbs up if you find it informative, share it with your friends who are on the lookout for new construction homes, and subscribe to our channel for more builder information.

Make sure to drop your questions or feedback in the comments section, we love hearing from you! Stay tuned for more exciting content coming your way.
